candidate_relations.scope_detail: mutation-defined tumor category omitting lineage and associated AML

candidate_relations.scope_detail: distinct non-Langerhans histiocytosis

candidate_relations.scope_detail: broad molecular disorder category without histologic or composite specificity

candidate_relations.scope_detail: melanocytic lineage conflicts with the biopsy phenotype

candidate_relations.scope_detail: shared molecular signature without the two clinical diagnostic entities

candidate_relations.scope_detail: single-mutation neoplasm category without lineage or composite specificity
